 Follow Stanislaus County prepares for Election Day
 Gabriel Porras Updated Tue, November 3, 2026 at 2:02 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. ABC10 Voting is already underway in Stanislaus County, where congressional races in Districts 5 and 13 are drawing attention. District 13 was the tightest House race in the country during the last election, and officials are preparing for another closely watched Election Day.
 Most voting centers in the county have been open for several days, and for hundreds of election workers and volunteers, preparations have been underway for weeks.
 On the eve of the election, around 250 workers and volunteers are staffing busy ballot drop boxes and voting centers throughout the county.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "A little bit, but it's also exhilarating," said Donna Linder, the county's registrar of voters. "We have been seeing at least a 28% larger turnout for early voting here at the office with our vote by mail and with our busier voting locations."
 Her staff is already processing some of those ballots ahead of Election Day, allowing workers to focus on voters when they need assistance.
 Linder says that the election has been smooth so far across the county.
 "Tomorrow is all about voters. So, tomorrow, we'll just be processing anything voters need, taking care of voters, answering all their questions," Linder said. "We haven't seen anything that would cause pause or even a hiccup. Everything's been running super smooth."
 Advertisement Advertisement Election workers are not expecting much rest once Election Day arrives.
 Linder said staff members will likely be working until 1 or 2 a.m. before returning at 8 a.m. the following morning.
 "We're just excited to have every single voter get out and vote," Linder said.
